note: Refutations and UX-centric critique points of the Anchor Re-architecture Implementation Plan.

findings.section: Wave 9 — W9 — Auth Enforce + Cookie Navigation + Ops Cutover (C2 gate)
findings.criterion: 2. One route table, declarative auth, default-deny
findings.message: When ANCHOR_TOKEN is rotated, the iPhone PWA's installed start URL containing the old token becomes invalid. Because the server returns a 401 with no login/token entry form, the PWA is completely stranded with no way to re-authenticate other than deleting it from the home screen and re-adding it. This creates a highly frustrated UX for daily mobile use.

findings.topic: PTY Active Process Loss on Restart
findings.section: Wave 17 — W17 — C4 Live Demo + ConPTY Verdict Application
findings.message: If the ConPTY spike yields a NO verdict, PTYs remain dashboard-owned. While the 'drain' can capture documents and seed a warm-resume, the actual running OS processes (like active SSH sessions, REPLs, or running builds) inside the PTY will be terminated during an NSSM restart. Claiming this does not cost 'live terminal context' is misleading and hides a disruptive UX regression.

findings.section: Wave 16 — W16 — External Supervisor Service + Live Probes
findings.message: Persisting tail cursors directly to the job directory on every read/write creates a high risk of Windows file sharing violations (EACCES) when the dashboard reads and the supervisor writes concurrently. Under heavy log output, this contention will cause UI stalls or stream failures, breaking John's daily dashboard experience.

findings.section: Wave 12 — W12 — journal.py Core: emit() Choke Point + Three-Marker Lifecycle + Butler Envelope
findings.message: The startup reconciler lacks a concurrency lease or grace period for active writes. If a legacy write takes longer to complete, a concurrent reconciler run or health check will see the legacy write as missing and prematurely append an ABORTED marker. When the active write subsequently succeeds and tries to append CONFIRM, the journal stream will be corrupted with conflicting markers.
